title: upgrade yamux once libp2p/rust-libp2p#5410 is resolved
description:
## Why
libp2p-yamux v0.47.0 (current latest) is pinned to yamux 0.12.1, which has a high-severity remote panic vulnerability (CVE: malformed Data frame with SYN set). The fix is in yamux 0.13.10, but upgrading is blocked upstream by a deadlock bug in libp2p_stream.

Upstream tracking issue: https://github.com/libp2p/rust-libp2p/issues/5410

## What
When rust-libp2p#5410 is closed and libp2p-yamux releases a version depending on yamux ^0.13:
- Run `cargo update -p yamux` (or update the libp2p version pin in Cargo.toml)
- Verify `cargo tree -p stoa-transit | grep yamux` shows only 0.13.x
- Run full test suite
- Dismiss the GitHub Dependabot alerts for yamux

## Note
Subscribe to https://github.com/libp2p/rust-libp2p/issues/5410 for upstream progress.
notes: Dependabot alerts #1, #3, #18 on MarkAtwood/stoa are all this same issue.
